narrative_before: This is a documented CTID emulation of APT29 (attributed to the Russian SVR), modelling TTPs reported from real 2016-2018 intrusions (e.g. FireEye 'No Easy Breach' and PowerDuke post-election campaigns). A user clicks a malicious payload delivered by spearphishing, compromising the initial victim workstation; the attacker performs rapid collection and exfiltration, then deploys a stealthier toolkit, bypasses UAC, and dumps credentials (LSASS/SAM, browser and private keys). Using LDAP queries the attacker enumerates other hosts and creates a remote PowerShell (WinRM) session to a secondary victim workstation, uploading and executing a payload via PsExec with stolen domain credentials. The attacker then creates a WinRM session to the domain controller and dumps the KRBTGT account hash to forge a Kerberos golden ticket, establishing persistence across the three-host domain.

detection_moments.description: Initial breach: spearphishing payload executed on the initial victim; rapid collection and exfil over C2.
detection_moments.evidence: 'a legitimate user clicking on a malicious payload delivered via a ... spearphishing campaign ... gathering and exfiltrating data' - APT29 Operations Flow / Scenario 1

detection_moments.description: Credential dumping, then LDAP enumeration and WinRM + PsExec lateral movement to the secondary victim.
detection_moments.evidence: 'creating a remote PowerShell session to a secondary victim ... executed on the secondary victim via the PSExec utility ... using the previously stolen credentials' - APT29 Scenario 1 Step 8

detection_moments.description: WinRM session to the domain controller; KRBTGT hash dumped to forge a Kerberos golden ticket (Scenario 2).
detection_moments.evidence: 'uses the previously dumped credentials ... to create a remote PowerShell session to the domain controller ... dumps the hash of the KRBTGT account' - APT29 Scenario 2 Step 16

attack_path: WinRM remote PowerShell + PsExec with stolen domain credentials - T1021.006 / T1021.002 / T1569.002
WinRM session to domain controller, KRBTGT dump for golden ticket - T1021.006 / T1558.001
ambiguities: Documented emulation of a real actor; year 2018 chosen for the 2016-2018 TTP basis (PowerDuke/No Easy Breach).
Target environment is 3 role-based hosts (DC + 2 workstations); no real-victim hostnames.
Scenarios 1 and 2 are merged into one host model (initial victim, secondary victim, DC) since both share the same 3-host topology.
